main_visual_task: A single roasted coffee bean turns morning light into liquid gold through a chain of physical transformations - crack, grind, bloom, pour - told in four motivated internal shots with no people.

user_script_review.note: 方向1「一粒豆子的日出」8镜两段分镜表获用户选定（飞书）

prompt_bible.subject_lock: one unlabeled transparent glass pour-over set - carafe, paper filter, dark roasted beans, golden espresso liquid; no branding anywhere
prompt_bible.environment_lock: sunlit wooden cafe table beside a rain-fresh window, soft blue morning city light outside, no people inside or outside
prompt_bible.material_lock: real oily bean surfaces, fine coffee powder, paper filter fibers, glass refraction, crema bubbles and rising steam, all physically plausible
prompt_bible.lighting_lock: hard warm sunrise key from upper left with a fixed cool blue fill from the window
prompt_bible.palette_lock: deep espresso brown, morning gold, cool window blue, transparent glass highlights
prompt_bible.lens_texture: photoreal commercial tabletop cinematography, macro depth of field, crisp glass and steam wisps, controlled high-speed bursts
prompt_bible.screen_direction: energy and liquid travel left-to-right across cuts; the carafe stays right of center; label areas remain blank
prompt_bible.audio_policy: four diegetic rhythmic accents: bean crack, grinder pulse, water spiral hiss, carafe pour; no voice

internal_shots.visual_state: one glossy dark roasted bean lies in a narrow shaft of sunrise light on the wooden table
internal_shots.subject_action: the bean seam splits with a visible spring and a wisp of aroma escapes
internal_shots.camera_action: locked high-speed macro camera; the subject motion supplies the energy
internal_shots.focus: bean seam and escaping aroma wisp
internal_shots.lighting_state: sunrise key rims the bean crest while cool blue fill holds the shadows
internal_shots.end_state: the aroma wisp drifts right as the crack springs fully open

camera_plan.motivation: let the smallest object open the film with tactile calm
camera_plan.start_position: extreme macro level with the single bean on wood
camera_plan.path: camera stays locked on the bean in its shaft of light
camera_plan.focus_transition: bean seam to escaping aroma wisp
camera_plan.stop_condition: cut exactly when the crack springs open

internal_shots.visual_state: fine dark coffee powder falls and builds a soft cone inside the paper filter
internal_shots.subject_action: the powder mound grows and glossy oil flecks catch the raking light
internal_shots.camera_action: one slow push-in toward the growing mound
internal_shots.focus: falling particles then the mound crest
internal_shots.lighting_state: sunrise key rakes across the powder texture
internal_shots.end_state: the mound crest quivers as the first water touches it

camera_plan.motivation: turn the crack's promise into tactile abundance
camera_plan.start_position: medium macro above the filter rim
camera_plan.path: push straight down toward the powder cone crest
camera_plan.speed_curve: slow constant push with no acceleration
camera_plan.focus_transition: falling grains to mound crest to first damp spot
camera_plan.end_position: close macro on the damp cone crest
camera_plan.axis_lock: powder falls front-to-back; camera axis vertical only
camera_plan.stop_condition: cut when the first water drop darkens the crest

internal_shots.visual_state: a thin water spiral sweeps across the coffee bed and the grounds swell into a bubbling crust
internal_shots.subject_action: the bloom rises, exhaling steam and glistening oils
internal_shots.camera_action: one slow short orbit around the blooming bed
internal_shots.focus: spiral water tongue and swelling crust
internal_shots.lighting_state: sunrise key strobes softly through rising steam
internal_shots.end_state: the crust sinks into a dark glossy pool ready to draw

camera_plan.motivation: show extraction as a living breathing event
camera_plan.start_position: low macro orbit position at crust level
camera_plan.path: orbit a short thirty-degree arc around the crust center
camera_plan.focus_transition: water spiral to crust bubbles to glossy pool
camera_plan.end_position: low macro on the settled dark pool
camera_plan.axis_lock: orbit clockwise only with no vertical drift
camera_plan.stop_condition: cut when the pool surface turns mirror-still

internal_shots.visual_state: dark brewed coffee draws down and pours as a translucent amber column into the glass carafe
internal_shots.subject_action: the falling column braids with light and swelling bubbles
internal_shots.camera_action: one vertical tracking move descending with the pour
internal_shots.focus: column braids and the carafe fill line
internal_shots.lighting_state: sunrise key refracts through glass into liquid gold
internal_shots.end_state: the carafe brims full and glows with steam curling off its neck

camera_plan.motivation: bank the whole transformation into one luminous volume
camera_plan.start_position: macro level with the filter outlet
camera_plan.path: track straight down alongside the falling column to the carafe
camera_plan.speed_curve: match the pour speed then ease as the carafe fills
camera_plan.focus_transition: outlet stream to column braids to rising fill line
camera_plan.end_position: close macro on the full amber carafe
camera_plan.axis_lock: vertical descent only with the pour left-of-center
camera_plan.stop_condition: cut on the brim-full glow before any overflow

first_frame: extreme macro of one glossy roasted coffee bean lying in a shaft of sunrise light
last_frame: close macro of the brimming amber glass carafe glowing in sunrise light
